subject: english
question:
Choose the best option to replace the underlined part to improve the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select 'No substitution.'

We must __**prevent him to making**__ the same mistake again.
solution:
The correct answer is '**2**' i.e. 'Prevent him from making'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "prevent him to making" is grammatically incorrect. The correct preposition to use after "prevent" is "from."
 
• The correct structure is "prevent someone from doing something."
